items.title: Half of Europe witnessed record heat stress this summer — EU
items.description: The EU's climate monitor said this summer was third-warmest for the continent on record. European rivers also registered their lowest average flows since records began in 1992.

items.title: May heatwaves, deaths, ruined harvests: study of Europe’s summer paints grim picture for the future

items.title: EU ministers mull new ways to curb irregular migration
items.description: The proposals include setting up so-called return hubs outside the EU and strengthening the border agency Frontex. Greece has even proposed temporarily suspending asylum applications in emergency situations.

items.title: Spain's parliament rejects housing bill as protests continue
items.description: Spain's minority government suffered defeat in parliament as it tried to push through a pair of emergency measures aimed at making housing more affordable. A pensioner's eviction and protests led to the bid.

items.title: Europe to release diesel reserves after Trump request
items.description: The US leader asked European countries to release some of their diesel reserves to ease the rising prices. The issue has damaged Trump's popularity back home.
